build_airdialogue_data: build the AirDialogue dataset by downloading and extracting data to the specified datapath
run_build_function: run the build function to download and set up the AirDialogue dataset for ParlAI
download_airdialogue_resources: download the AirDialogue dataset tar.gz file from Google Storage using the RESOURCES list
check_airdialogue_version: check if the AirDialogue dataset is already built at version 1.0 before downloading
remove_old_airdialogue_data: remove an outdated AirDialogue dataset directory before rebuilding with the latest version
